_lane: sim-rgbd-arm-collision-aware-v1 (PR-A: cart as cuMotion world obstacle)
_what: The rollwagen is rigidly coupled, so its pose is KNOWN after couple, yet the forward wrist
ESDF never covers it (measured grid y_min -0.08 m; cart at base y ~ -0.8 m). So the set-down
phase is structurally blind and today leans on the cage_collision pair-filter + collision-OFF
straight-line inserts. Publishing the cart's authored collider geometry as cuMotion world
CollisionObjects (the existing `world_obstacles` HOST key, today []) makes the arm + attached
carton plan around the real deck / cage uprights / drawbar with ZERO VRAM and no perception.
Opt-in and byte-identical off: nothing new is published unless `world_obstacles` carries these
specs. The ground-truth collect TARGET is a separate decision and stays.
_generate: where (CART_X, CART_Y, CART_Z, CART_YAW) is the coupled cart-body pose in ur_base_link (the known
hitch transform at the set-down park). rollwagen_world_obstacle_specs_from_usd needs pxr (usd-core);
offline/no-USD callers pass an explicit {name:(lo,hi)} collider dict to rollwagen_world_obstacle_specs.
The cage posts/side/back bars group under one `rollwagen_cage` obstacle; each horizontal support
(deck/shelf/drawbar) stays its own box so a place is checked against exactly the deck.

boxes: ... one box per cage post / side bar (illustrative geometry; the real values come from the
authored cart colliders + the coupled pose) ...

host_config_keys._note: Publish these together with retiring the set-down crutches once S0 proves they cover the

asserts: a deck-penetrating place has NEGATIVE world-obstacle clearance (cuMotion INVALID_INITIAL_CSPACE)
a standoff above the deck is clear
the cage posts group under rollwagen_cage; deck/shelf/drawbar stay separate
every emitted spec round-trips through the host loader world_obstacles.boxes_from_specs
the cart obstacles clear the arm at its rest config (dataset arm URDF/XRDF present)

s0_gpu_acceptance: A bounded (<=20 min) collect/set-down run with these world_obstacles published and NO cage_collision
filter and NO straight-line insert on the place: the set-down plans around the cart (cuMotion
succeeds), the carton sets down level (box-parallel bound 2.0 deg, 0.15 s grace, never loosened),
and nothing is visually wrong on camera. gpu_budget fits=True; lock only when free; never --force.
